authority: MV-IA-F006/F007 authoritative Action and combat resolution
MV-IA-F020/F021 permissions, hidden information and recovery
principles: Authorize and filter before Species/Form existence, body details, variants, hidden forms, vulnerabilities, compare targets, counts, provenance, exports, diagnostics, notifications or AI context are serialized or aggregated.

Reusable Species Definition, lineage/variant, Form Definition, biological trait/Ability Definition, morphology/body-plan facts, Character selection, current body/form state, transformation/Adaptation state, physiology, compatibility, bioengineering, visibility and provenance remain distinguishable layers.

Culture, society, belief, profession, learned behavior, equipment, temporary Effects/Conditions and Campaign environment never become immutable biology merely because they appear beside Species content.

Species eligibility, dataset membership, tree adjacency, same-name records, source-document grouping and visual similarity are insufficient to establish biology ownership, lineage, Form identity, compatibility or exact mechanics.

Unknown or source-unspecified anatomy, physiology, movement, lifespan, compatibility, limitation or Adaptation state is never replaced with a human default, universal compatibility, absence, zero or fabricated value.
A Form Definition is distinct from a Character currently using that form; accepted transformations change server-authoritative current state and append history without rewriting source Definitions.
The governed 2,203-row Species/Elementalist/Innate Ability surface remains mixed Ability-domain source; no row becomes biological merely because it is Species-gated or stored in that dataset.
The 60 detailed and 57 pricing-only Shapeshifter rows remain separate review surfaces with zero automatic merges by name, tier, position or similarity.

Every selection, comparison, transformation and Adaptation operation has keyboard, touch and nonvisual alternatives; color, silhouette, body diagrams, drag, hover and animation are never the sole carrier of meaning.

visibility_classes.definition_public: Published Species/Form/trait fields permitted to the viewer.
visibility_classes.character_visible: Character biological selections and current state authorized to the viewer.
visibility_classes.character_private: Private Character biology or appearance-linked fields scoped to the subject and explicit policy.
visibility_classes.campaign_revealed: Campaign facts about forms, weaknesses or transformations revealed to the viewer.
visibility_classes.campaign_gm_private: Campaign-GM-only biological truth, hidden forms, weaknesses, transformation triggers or diagnostics.
visibility_classes.source_diagnostic: Source/conflict/inference/provenance diagnostics limited by provenance permission.
visibility_classes.transaction_private: Bioengineering, respec/correction or governed modification details limited to authorized participants.
visibility_classes.service_minimum: Operation-specific minimum projection for services/AI; never independent biology authority.

field_groups.label: Species Identity & Definition
field_groups.projection_rule: Definition inspection never implies Character selection, current body state, culture-as-biology, or Campaign-local temporary state.

field_groups.label: Lineage, Subspecies & Species Variant
field_groups.projection_rule: Lineage/variant relationships require explicit source-backed evidence; same name, shared document or visual similarity never creates the relation.

field_groups.label: Form / Alternate-Form Definition
field_groups.projection_rule: A reusable Form Definition is not a Character current-form state and does not become active merely because the viewer can inspect it.

field_groups.label: Biological Trait, Species Perk & Innate Ability
field_groups.classification_rule: Species eligibility and mixed-dataset membership never prove physiology; learned, cultural, mystical, technological and mixed grants remain distinguishable.

field_groups.label: Morphology, Body Plan & Anatomy
field_groups.unknown_rule: Source absence remains unknown/source-unspecified; no normal-human anatomy is synthesized as a default.
field_groups.accessibility_rule: Every diagrammatic or appearance-linked fact has a textual equivalent and semantic label.

field_groups.label: Character Species / Form Selection & Grants
field_groups.mutation_rule: Selection stores stable references and accepted grants through MV-IA-F004; it never edits the reusable Definition.

field_groups.label: Current Body / Form State
field_groups.mutation_rule: Current form is server-authoritative Character/runtime state; reconnect restores it and transformations do not rewrite Species/Form Definitions.

field_groups.label: Transformation & Adaptation State
field_groups.classification_rule: Environment-based or Species-gated learned abilities do not automatically become biological Adaptations.
field_groups.mutation_rule: Accepted transformation/Adaptation changes are expected-version checked, idempotent and owned by the governing Ability/Action or Character workflow.

field_groups.label: Senses, Movement & Physiology
field_groups.projection_rule: Current environment may constrain or suppress capability without rewriting source physiology.
field_groups.unknown_rule: Unknown/source-unspecified physiology is not converted to a human baseline.

field_groups.label: Compatibility, Limits & Vulnerabilities
field_groups.projection_rule: Compatibility requires explicit source/rule evidence; absence of an incompatibility rule is not universal compatibility.
field_groups.privacy_rule: Hidden weaknesses and incompatibilities are filtered before comparisons, warnings, failures, counts and AI context.

field_groups.label: Bioengineering, Symbiosis & Biological Modification
field_groups.handoff: Kola-Ha Forms remain biological modification semantics; PPIA-03 Asset/cybernetic rules apply only where the source actually models an Asset or installed object.
field_groups.mutation_rule: Modification requires explicit authorization, compatibility evidence, expected version and append-only history.

field_groups.label: Knowledge, Reveal & Visibility
field_groups.privacy_rule: Authorization occurs before search, counts, variant lists, compare targets, warnings, exports, diagnostics, notifications and AI context.

field_groups.label: Source, Provenance, History & Recovery
field_groups.privacy_rule: History and provenance are role-filtered before aggregation/export.
field_groups.recovery_rule: Ambiguous mutation outcomes require operation-ID/status lookup before retry; successful retry reuses idempotency identity and never duplicates selection, transformation, Adaptation, bioengineering or respec effects.

role_projection.player: May see authorized source/revealed Species/Form facts plus own permitted Character selections/current state; hidden forms, weaknesses and GM/source truth remain absent rather than redacted aggregates.
role_projection.gm: Campaign-scoped authority may expose governed Campaign biological truth and hidden forms/weaknesses where policy permits; it does not grant unrelated user-private or other-Campaign Character biology.
role_projection.assistant_gm: Receives the minimum delegated projection and cannot independently choose Species/Form, transform, reveal, respec, bioengineer or promote content.
role_projection.creator_owner_admin: May author/govern within explicit scope but source facts, Character selection, live form state and Campaign reveal state remain separate write paths.
role_projection.service_ai: Receives minimum necessary role-safe fields with hidden forms/weaknesses removed and no independent mutation, classification or canonical-promotion authority.

filter before diff/count/facet generation
surface source/conflict/unknown state without inventing values
selection never edits reusable Definition
accepted grants retain source/version provenance
same-name/shared-document similarity cannot create relationship
choice preserves selected relationship provenance
source creature and playable Character/species remain separate identities
retained/normalized/excluded facts are attributable
current-form state changes without rewriting Form Definition
end/revert follows source/rules lifecycle rather than UI assumption
outcome and governed costs commit atomically
hidden forms or capabilities never leak through unauthorized failures
environment-linked learned abilities are not silently converted to biological Adaptations
history records acquisition/swap source
Ability execution never reclassifies the Ability as physiological
result and costs commit atomically
absence of incompatibility is not universal compatibility
unknown remains unknown and blocks or warns according to owning workflow
Kola-Ha biological Forms are not generic equipment
PPIA-03 Asset rules apply only to actual Asset/installed-object relations
history is append-only
correction adds attributable history and never erases prior accepted state
Definition/source records remain unchanged
authorization is recomputed before aggregates
revealed state is audience-scoped and does not alter source truth
same-name/tier/position/similarity are review hints only
Shapeshifter pricing rows retain zero automatic merges
proposal/recommendation is not source fact or automatic canonical promotion
filter before export
ambiguous mutation status lookup before retry
never expose hidden biological operation payloads to unauthorized viewers

responsive_accessibility_matrix.expanded_large: May use multi-column identity, morphology, traits, forms, compatibility and history regions while preserving semantic labels and source state.
responsive_accessibility_matrix.medium: Prioritize identity, source status, current Character/form state and primary selection/action; secondary regions collapse without losing validation meaning.
responsive_accessibility_matrix.compact: Single-column cards/sheets preserve Species/Form identity, current form, prerequisites, validation and primary action without hover or wide-table dependency.
responsive_accessibility_matrix.keyboard: All browse, compare, selection, lineage, Form, Adaptation, bioengineering, reveal and recovery actions are reachable with predictable focus order and no drag requirement.
responsive_accessibility_matrix.screen_reader: Announce semantic layer, source/conflict state, Species/Form identity, prerequisites, current form, Adaptation status, compatibility, hidden/revealed state, validation errors and resulting operation status.
responsive_accessibility_matrix.high_zoom_reflow: No horizontal dependency for selection or transformation completion; tables become labelled rows/cards while preserving relationships.
responsive_accessibility_matrix.reduced_motion: Transformation and form changes use state/text updates; animation is never the sole carrier of before/after state.
responsive_accessibility_matrix.nonvisual_morphology: Morphology, anatomy and appearance-linked biological facts have textual equivalents; body-diagram location is never required to understand rules.

acceptance_invariants: Species/Form Definition inspection cannot mutate Character selection or current body state.
Culture, learned behavior, equipment, temporary Effects/Conditions and Campaign environment cannot silently become immutable biology.
Species eligibility and mixed Ability-dataset membership cannot establish biology ownership by themselves.
Same-name, shared-document, visual similarity, tree adjacency or tier cannot create lineage, Form, compatibility or Shapeshifter merge authority.
Unknown/source-unspecified anatomy, physiology or compatibility remains unknown rather than human-default or universally compatible.
Hidden forms, weaknesses, transformations and private Character biology are filtered before counts, facets, compare results, warnings, exports, diagnostics, notifications and AI context.
Character Species/Form selection stores stable references and grants without rewriting reusable Definitions.
Transformations/Adaptations are server-authoritative and expected-version/idempotency controlled; governed costs and outcomes commit atomically.
Ambiguous network outcomes use operation ID/status lookup before retry and cannot duplicate transformations, Adaptation swaps, bioengineering changes or respec effects.
The 60 detailed and 57 pricing-only Shapeshifter rows preserve zero automatic merges.
Kola-Ha biological Forms remain distinct from generic equipment unless source/rules explicitly model an Asset relation.
Every required flow remains usable without color, drag, hover, animation, body-diagram pointing or visual silhouette recognition.
